//buildCommand: Migrations are deliberately NOT run here. The project setting was 'prisma migrate deploy && prisma generate && npm run build', which meant every build took a postgres advisory lock. Two builds at once, a push landing on top of a redeploy, and they deadlock: both died with P1002 'Timed out trying to acquire a postgres advisory lock'. Schema changes are applied with `npx prisma migrate deploy` as a deliberate step instead, so a deploy can never be blocked by, or race, a migration.
